subject: Hospitality
title: Las Vegas: Hotels as Entertainment
description: A short lesson to help you apply Las Vegas: Hotels as Entertainment.

hook.text: Las Vegas redefined the hotel by making it a destination, not just accommodation. The hotel IS the experience.

buildup.text: Bugsy Siegel's Flamingo (1946) combined gambling, shows, dining, and rooms in one resort. Everything under one roof.

discovery.text: Vegas hotels realized rooms were loss leaders. The real profit came from casinos, restaurants, and entertainment.

twist.text: The MGM Grand has 6,852 rooms—more than some entire countries have hotel rooms. Scale became the strategy.

climax.text: Vegas proved hotels could be theme parks, concert halls, and shopping malls simultaneously. The industry took notes.

punchline.text: Sleep is secondary. Vegas hotels sell everything but rest.

quiz.question: How did Las Vegas change the hotel industry?
options: By making the hotel itself the destination and entertainment
